mostWorthwhile.text: Following pyruvate into aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the illustration plan distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen’s role and connects proton movement to ATP synthesis.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was predictable after installing the glucose carrier, although it established where the pump works.

surprise.text: Protein synthesis automatically included the glycolytic cytosol, making the energy connection explicit in a combination I expected to focus on amino acids and ribosomes.

arbitrary.text: The automatic use of glycolytic cytosol for protein synthesis was not obvious from the chosen pair, although the resulting energy-coupling inset gives it a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contrasting transport mechanisms and linked energy pathways made the constructions informative. The planned illustrations, rather than finished artwork, are what I can judge here.
